capabilities.current_evidence_or_remaining_work: Indexed/unindexed triangle buffers, live aspects and ordinary transforms through Graphic3d factories; only unlit opaque solid styles. Twelve native viewer captures plus CPU submission and live Vulkan mutation tests. Both lavapipe and native RADV profiles retain PNG/depth captures and explicit device identity.
Orthographic and perspective snapshots checked. Stereo, tiled/large-coordinate and persistent transforms remain pending.

V3d ToPixMap reaches Vulkan through framebuffer targets; RGBA8 and D32 readback, RGB/red conversion and padded/bottom-up rows tested. MSAA, HDR, tiled capture, sRGB and alternate formats remain pending.

Graphic3d factories, V3d creation/redraw/resize, camera and geometry updates, visibility, erase, capture failure and removal tested. AIS display/erase, bulk/selected transitions, permanent removal/recreation and presentation clearing now submit real custom-object presentations and selection lifecycle, with mode changes and affinity covered. Wider built-in AIS presentations, highlight rendering, connected/shadow structures, subviews, cached immediate redraw and native presentation remain open.
Native window swapchains, platform lifetime, presentation and device/surface loss.
Lines, points, strips, fans, normals, bound colors, edges, silhouettes, culling, polygon offsets and stencil.
Flat/Gouraud/Phong/PBR, light sets, materials and shadows.
PBR IBL, cubemaps, environment backgrounds and baking.
Texture formats, samplers, UV transforms and custom shader contract.
Alpha mask/blend, sorted transparency, weighted OIT and depth peeling.
View/structure clipping and capping, clip chains, section materials.
Fonts, text placement/orientation, marker sprites and billboard behavior.

Ordered normal/immediate layers, priorities and depth clear/test/write submitted to Vulkan; solid background, default/full native captures and custom depth-policy runtime assertions. Layer removal preserves structures. Gradient/image backgrounds, origin/culling and complete immediate-pass behavior remain open.
Legacy ray tracing, path tracing, GI, sampling, DOF and tone mapping.
Stereo modes, anaglyph/interlaced output, external composer and HMD paths.
Performance counters, HUD/chart, diagnostics and GPU memory reports.

Owned Vulkan buffers/images/pipelines, repeated frame resize and invalid device tested; caching, sharing and context/device loss remain pending. Release benchmarks cover redraw, 256 draws and resize on software/native devices with compatible-baseline regression budgets; allocation caching and GPU-only timing remain open.
